# Web3Chess

> Web3Chess is a chess game that runs inside Telegram as a Mini App (bot: @chess_matbot) and in a web browser. Players can practise free against Free Coach, a computer opponent, work through 100 Academy tactics levels, and play other people in optional USDT matches with equal stakes. Wager matches are 18+ where available, and players can lose their stake.

Facts on this page match the public website as of 2026-11-11. The pages linked below are the source of truth when they differ.

## How to play

- Telegram: open https://t.me/chess_matbot/Web3Chess. The Mini App signs players in with their Telegram profile; there is no separate download or password.
- Browser: https://app.web3chess.online, with sign-in through Telegram to keep rating and match history.
- Free: Free Coach games and the 100 Academy tactics levels cost nothing.

## USDT matches (optional, 18+)

- Both players stake the same amount. Stake tiers: 1, 5, 10 or 25 USDT.
- Decided match: the winner receives 95% of the combined pot in their app balance. 3% is the platform fee and 2% goes to the referral pool.
- Draws (stalemate, threefold repetition, 50-move rule, agreement) return both stakes in full.
- Clocks: 1, 3, 5, 10, 15, 30 or 60 minutes per side, no increment. A flagged clock loses. If a player does not make a first move within 30 seconds, the match is aborted and both stakes are refunded.
- Deposits: USDT sent to the address shown in the app's Wallet tab, with the player's reference comment.
- Withdrawals: requested in the app and confirmed by the player in the Telegram bot chat. Timing depends on processing and network confirmation. Web3Chess holds app balances until withdrawal.
- Rules for real-money play differ by country. Players must check local eligibility.

## Main pages

- [Play chess in Telegram or the browser](https://web3chess.online/play): launch options and FAQ.
- [How to play chess in Telegram](https://web3chess.online/how-it-works): starting a game, inviting a friend from a chat, time controls.
- [Play chess for money with USDT stakes](https://web3chess.online/wagers): stake tiers, pot split, draws, deposits and withdrawals.
- [Free chess puzzles and tactics trainer](https://web3chess.online/academy): 100 tactics levels and Free Coach practice.
- [Fair play and anti-cheat](https://web3chess.online/fair-play): move validation on the server, clocks and fair-play rules.
- [Chess rules for beginners](https://web3chess.online/rules): how pieces move, castling, en passant, check, checkmate, stalemate and chess clocks.
- [Chess articles](https://web3chess.online/blog): openings, tactics, endgames and blitz time management. Full list in the [RSS feed](https://web3chess.online/feed.xml).
- [Terms of Service](https://web3chess.online/terms) and [Privacy Policy](https://web3chess.online/privacy).
